from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action (案由) associated with the case")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentInfo]
